title: Raise the AlgoChat note ceiling to 4096 bytes
description: Raise the AlgoChat note ceiling to 4096 bytes
acceptance_criteria: An 882-byte standard plaintext and an 878-byte PSK plaintext still encrypt, and those notes are at most 1024 bytes. Plaintexts of 3954 and 3950 bytes encode to exactly 4096 bytes. One extra byte fails before a transaction is built. payment_fee at min_fee 1000 returns 1000, 1098, and 1308 for notes of 1024, 2000, and 4096. Headers stay 126 and 130 and the tag stays 16. Cargo.toml is 0.3.0.
